guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 以「拆除前盤點、選擇性拆解與多物料品質追蹤」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
guides.conceptEn: Follow pre-demolition inventory, selective dismantling and multi-material traceability through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
procedure: 在「拆除前材料清冊」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 30 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「圖面與現況不符會使車次與暫存估算失真。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「不確定材料的隔離分類」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.75 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「用外觀或年齡推論材質會產生錯誤放行。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「選擇性拆解順序」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.75 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「將可用門窗混入破碎流會不可逆地失去完整件價值。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「現場料箱與混入率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.02 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只增加料箱數而不改善動線可能無法降低混入。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「破碎與粒徑分級」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 9 tonne/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把尺寸合格視為材質合格會漏掉同尺寸污染。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「金屬、輕物與礦物分流」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.9 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以磁選總重當純金屬會高估回收品質。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「石膏與細料交叉污染」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.01 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「先混後分可能讓細粉沾附所有顆粒而難以去除。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「運輸、堆置與實際密度」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 16.8 tonne，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「使用混凝土實體密度計鬆散料會錯估車次。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「分流率與用途去向」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.85 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把暫存當最終回收會重複計算或高估績效。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「批次品質與數位追溯」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0 tonne residual，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「不同日期或含水基準混算會製造假的物料損失。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
procedureEn: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for pre-demolition material inventory, first reproduce 30 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Drawing/site differences distort haul and storage estimates." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for segregating uncertain materials, first reproduce 0.75 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Inferring material from appearance or age can cause false release." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for selective dismantling sequence, first reproduce 0.75 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Sending usable doors/windows to crushing irreversibly loses component value." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for on-site bins and contamination rate, first reproduce 0.02 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "More bins without better logistics may not reduce contamination." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for crushing and size classification, first reproduce 9 tonne/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Treating correct size as correct material misses same-sized contamination." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for metal, light and mineral streams, first reproduce 0.9 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Calling all magnetic mass pure metal overstates quality." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for gypsum and fines cross-contamination, first reproduce 0.01 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Mixing first can coat particles with fines that are difficult to remove." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for transport, stockpiles and bulk density, first reproduce 16.8 tonne, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using solid concrete density for loose debris misestimates haul trips." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for diversion rate and destination, first reproduce 0.85 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Counting storage as final recycling can double-count or overstate outcomes." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for lot quality and digital traceability, first reproduce 0 tonne residual, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Mixing dates or moisture bases creates false material losses." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.
evidence: 以圖面估算並用現場量測修正孔洞。
把未確認的六處保持待判定並列出所缺證據。
比較保護包裝前後的完整構件數。
比較靠近拆解點與遠端料箱的混入率。
分析每個粒級的材質組成而非只報篩上重量。
量測金屬出口夾帶砂漿與礦物出口殘金屬。
比較源頭分流與混合後分選的殘留量。
以地磅和車斗量測反算不同含水料的鬆散密度。
把接收證明與實際用途逐批配對。
加入一筆重複運單，觀察收支與追溯檢查如何抓錯。
evidenceEn: Estimate from drawings and correct openings with field measurements.
Keep six unverified locations pending and list missing evidence.
Compare intact component counts with and without protective packaging.
Compare bins close to dismantling points with distant bins.
Analyze material composition in each size class, not only oversize mass.
Measure mortar entrainment in metal and metal remaining in minerals.
Compare residuals from source separation and sorting after mixing.
Infer bulk density from weighbridge and bin measurements at different moisture levels.
Match receiving records and actual use by batch.
Insert a duplicate haul ticket and observe mass-balance and traceability flags.
pitfalls: 圖面與現況不符會使車次與暫存估算失真。
用外觀或年齡推論材質會產生錯誤放行。
將可用門窗混入破碎流會不可逆地失去完整件價值。
只增加料箱數而不改善動線可能無法降低混入。
把尺寸合格視為材質合格會漏掉同尺寸污染。
以磁選總重當純金屬會高估回收品質。
先混後分可能讓細粉沾附所有顆粒而難以去除。
使用混凝土實體密度計鬆散料會錯估車次。
把暫存當最終回收會重複計算或高估績效。
不同日期或含水基準混算會製造假的物料損失。
pitfallsEn: Drawing/site differences distort haul and storage estimates.
Inferring material from appearance or age can cause false release.
Sending usable doors/windows to crushing irreversibly loses component value.
More bins without better logistics may not reduce contamination.
Treating correct size as correct material misses same-sized contamination.
Calling all magnetic mass pure metal overstates quality.
Mixing first can coat particles with fines that are difficult to remove.
Using solid concrete density for loose debris misestimates haul trips.
Counting storage as final recycling can double-count or overstate outcomes.
Mixing dates or moisture bases creates false material losses.

guides.scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 垃圾自動真空收集
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。
courses.summaryEn: The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
